item.title: 0.10.0-beta.5
item.description:
Aki 0.10.0 beta

New

  • Right-click a limits ring to choose, for that AI alone, what it shows and the line under it: the time left in the 5-hour session, the time until the week renews, or the month on plans with a monthly limit.
  • The limits card shows the models you used this week, the days in a row and your busiest day.
  • Codex card: "More from Codex" (off until you click Show) adds your limit resets saved, all-time numbers, longest task and what you call most, asked of OpenAI with the sign-in Codex keeps on your Mac.

item.title: 0.10.0-beta.3
item.description:
Aki 0.10.0 beta

New

  • Right-click a limits ring to choose, for that AI alone, what it shows and the line under it: the time left in the 5-hour session, the time until the week renews, or the month on plans with a monthly limit.
  • The limits card shows the models you used this week, the days in a row and your busiest day.
  • Codex card: "More from Codex" (off until you click Show) adds your limit resets saved, all-time numbers, longest task and what you call most, asked of OpenAI with the sign-in Codex keeps on your Mac.

Aki 0.9.0

New

  • Sent a mark to the wrong session? In History, "Send to another terminal" sends a copy to the right one and keeps the original where it went, even once it's done.

Fixed

  • A session's card stays open while you move the pointer up to it: the rings and the drag handle on the way no longer close it or swap it for another.

Aki 0.8.9

Much lighter on your Mac

  • Aki now uses a small fraction of the processor it used before when it's just sitting there: the rings and the agents' symbols turn in Core Animation, and what Aki reads (sessions, Codex logs, processes) is read again only when it changes.
  • A busy or stuck app (Orca, the Codex or Claude app, git) can no longer freeze Aki.

Fixed

  • Aki never types into a terminal while Claude Code is asking you something (a permission): its Enter used to answer it. The marks wait and go once you've answered.
  • Sending to the Codex and Claude apps is reliable: a mark with only a picture goes with its picture, text you already wrote goes along, History's send arrow sends what didn't go (and never twice), and a message left in the app's box says so instead of "Sent".
  • Marks sent while another send is going wait their turn instead of being lost.
  • On a light Mac the sidebar and its cards are light, instead of black glass under dark text.
  • The folded sidebar is easier to catch and doesn't fold the moment the pointer strays.
  • Esc on a queued mark you opened again no longer deletes it; the picture limit never deletes a pending mark's picture; an update never restarts Aki mid-send.
  • The Screen Recording alert offers to restart Aki when it comes back.
  • aki wait returns marks sent while the agent was busy, and running aki from an agent's shell no longer opens a second Aki.

Aki 0.8.8

Fixed

  • The send arrow in History works again for the Codex and Claude apps: a mark that didn't go is sent again (from the box when it's still there), and one that already went isn't sent twice.
  • Marks sent to a new Codex conversation are counted as sent: Aki waits a little longer for the message to show.
